mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong residential construction activity, which signals robust consumer spending and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above its 50th percentile is followed by negative 20d returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.5% is followed by negative 20d returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint condition of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling is followed by negative 20d returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% is followed by positive 20d returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, signaling weakening economic activity and reduced corporate earnings growth, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 100.0 is followed by positive 20d returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates broad-based economic expansion, supporting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint condition of HOUST rising and INDPRO rising is followed by negative 20d returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate profitability, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS above 2.0% is followed by positive 60d returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates immediate manufacturing contraction, triggering short-term equity selling pressure and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 100.0 is followed by positive 5d returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.
